skill.summary: Turns a nonfiction argument into a clear claim-evidence-assumption-objection map.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Argument Map Builder.

- Turns nonfiction arguments into claim-evidence-assumption-objection maps.
- Guides users through input collection and maps main claim, supporting reasons, evidence, assumptions, and counterarguments.
- Labels inferred items and surfaces gaps or ambiguities in the argument.
- Prioritizes safe, reflective use for personal knowledge and reading support.
- Does not perform academic grading or deliver professional advice.
